revisions.name: $wnd_send_message_inner
revisions.reason: Completed USER cdecl return consumes exactly four retained arguments after existing child/root/depth verification, matching modal-pump legacy callback compatibility. The original full-frame guard still rejects partial or excess RET n; no ownership bypass or new continuation. Real nested x86 cdecl, malformed RET 4/8/12/20, leaked/replaced invocation and threaded modal subclass tests cover the boundary.
